subject: Re: Renewal options + surge protection for Q4 product launch
messages:
From: Tara Bhatnagar <tara@arkadia.io>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Liang <marcus.liang@arkadia.io>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal outlook + surge protection request

Hi Sean —

Hope youre well. Were starting renewal planning for our account (current commit: 12M tokens / month) ahead of a hard product launch in Q4. Two asks from our side:

1) Can Redwood provide a short-term price hold for the first 6–9 months of a renewal term (we need predictable unit costs during launch)
2) Surge protection / credits for an expected spike (were projecting +60% peak traffic for ~8 weeks) — ideally some one-off buffer credits rather than permanent higher commits

Attached is a usage snapshot for May to show the baseline. Wed like to align next week if possible.

Thanks —
Tara Bhatnagar
Head of Platform Partnerships
Arkadia, Inc.
T: 415-555-0198
Attachment: arkadia_usage_may.pdf (PDF, 320KB)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Tara Bhatnagar <tara@arkadia.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal outlook + surge protection request

Tara —

Thanks for the context and the usage file. Congrats on the upcoming launch — big moment. Quick read and a couple of options that I think map to what youre asking: 

Option A (Launch Guard):
- 9-month price hold at current per-token rate for baseline usage (up to 110% of current commit)
- One-time surge credit equal to 25% of estimated incremental cost for the 8-week peak
- Short canary for larger bursts (automated fallback to higher-cost burst pool after 95th percentile)

Option B (Commit Ramp + Discount):
- Increase committed capacity by 30% for 12 months (lower unit price on commit tiers)
- First-quarter ramp credit of 20% if Arkadias actual usage exceeds commit in months 1–3

Were happy to mix elements (e.g., 6-month hold + smaller surge credit) if margin or procurement constraints require it. Attaching a first-pass term sheet to kick off internal review.

If that looks reasonable I can schedule a quick call Monday/Tuesday to lock details and get Priyom/Monicas input.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_proposed_term_sheet_v1.pdf (PDF, 210KB)
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal outlook + surge protection request

Looping in margin/legal considerations —

Quick notes after skimming the term sheet:
- 9-month full price hold + 25% surge credit looks expensive relative to existing commit economics.
- Proposal: offer a 6-month hold, 15% renewal discount on the new committed tiers, and a 15% surge credit (cap the credit to a $X ceiling tied to estimated incremental spend).
- Need legal to vet language around automated fallbacks and SLA implications for burst pool.

Attached my margin calc for Arkadia based on their May file. If we want to keep sales momentum we can accept reduced hold duration in exchange for a higher committed uplift (30–40%) and a firm true-up mechanism at quarter end.

Thanks —
Priyom
Priyom Das
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: margin_calc_arkadia.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Tara Bhatnagar <tara@arkadia.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marcus Liang <marcus.liang@arkadia.io>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Revised offer: 6-month hold + tier uplift + capped surge credit

Tara —

Per internal review, heres a revised commercial we can put forward quickly: 

Summary (final offer):
- Term: 12 months starting July 1, 2027
- Commit: +35% committed tokens (from 12M -> 16.2M tokens/month)
- Price hold: 6 months at current per-token rate for baseline up to 110% of prior commit
- Renewal discount: 15% off list on the new committed tier after month 6
- Surge protection: one-time credit equal to 15% of incremental spend during the 8-week peak (credit capped at $25,000)
- True-up: quarterly true-up with transparent usage report and one right-sized adjustment window in month 3

We believe this balances Arkadias need for predictability at launch and Redwoods economics. Ive attached a short term summary and created a DocuSign envelope for signature when youre ready.

Can you confirm internal alignment on Arkadias side by EOD next Tuesday so we can finalize the July 1 start?

Best —
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_final_term_summary.pdf (PDF, 95KB)
Related link: https://redwood.app/docusign/D-ARK-472
From: Tara Bhatnagar <tara@arkadia.io>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Liang <marcus.liang@arkadia.io>, Arkadia Sales <sales@arkadia.io>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 15:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Revised offer: 6-month hold + tier uplift + capped surge credit

Sean —

Thanks for running this internally and the quick turnaround. The revised terms look actionable and align with procurement constraints. Two small asks before we sign: 

1) Can you move the surge credit cap to $30,000 (we prefer a slightly higher cushion given variability)
2) Add a short clause that allows Arkadia to request a one-time temporary burst increase without immediate commit change (subject to rate)

If you can accept those two tweaks well route for signature today and complete the DocuSign this afternoon.

Regards —
Tara
Head of Platform Partnerships
Arkadia, Inc.
